pages.title: Respiration
pages.text: $(thing)Respiration$()$(br2)With air, a cell burns sugar all the way to carbon dioxide and gets fifteen times as much from it, pumping protons across a membrane to drive its turbine. Unlocks the Living Cell.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Metabolism, Membrane Potential.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Ion Channel Membrane, 2 Yeast Culture.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A proton gradient of p pH units and a voltage V (mV) drive the turbine together. Write the total push F, in mV, 59 mV for each pH unit.
